method.primary: CORP (PAV isotonic recalibration; Dimitriadis et al. 2021)
method.weighting: events weighted 1/n_valid(cell); cells contribute equally, matching the pipeline's unweighted per-cell mean loss

pooled.caveat: Pooled across models: base rates differ per model, and the cross forecast is shared across targets (zero between-model resolution by construction). Read the per-model decomposition as primary.
